title: Euler's Formula
subtitle: Complex Analysis · Complex exponential
summary: The complex exponential traces the unit circle as θ varies.
detail:
\[ e^{i\theta} = \cos\theta + i\sin\theta \]

Foundation of Fourier analysis, signal processing, and quantum mechanics. The magnitude is always 1; the argument is \(\theta\). Setting \(\theta=\pi\) gives Euler's identity.
